kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقعنسس (form XIV)
# أَقْعَنْسِسُ (ʔaqʕansisu) /ʔaq.ʕan.si.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# أَقْعَنْسِسَ (ʔaqʕansisa) /ʔaq.ʕan.si.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# أَقْعَنْسِسْ (ʔaqʕansis) /ʔaq.ʕan.sis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
